source_title: Woot’s Early Black Friday Sale Features Some Incredible Video Game Deals
source_excerpt:
Featuring deals for Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox.
Woot has just launched a special early Black Friday sale that's just for gamers . For starters, if you are shopping the sale, make sure to use SAVETOBER at checkout for an extra 20% off (up to $40 off your purchase. Woot (owned by Amazon) loves to welcome newbies as well, so new customers get 30% off (up to $60 off) with the same promo code as well.
But what's actually on sale? I'd suggest checking things out yourself at Woot, but I'll run over a few favorites myself while I'm here, especially the deals I suspect won't last much longer.
Unfortunately, you've likely already missed the best deal from the sale, which was on a Switch 2 console + game bundle for $479 . Considering we're seeing Switch 2 deals this early, I wouldn't be surprised if something similar returns in the next few weeks, so don't feel too downhearted if you missed out this time around.
Otherwise, the next best deal is also for the Switch 2; this time being the Switch 2 Pro Controller . Down to just $67.49 when using the SAVETOBER promo code, this is some serious savings and well worth picking up while the discount is still live.
There are also games like Metroid Prime 4: Beyond for Switch 2, $49.99 before using the promo code, down to $34.99 for new customers, or $39.99 for anyone else utilizing the SAVETOBER deal.
Metroid Prime 4: Beyond Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
There's loads of other Switch games up for grabs, as per usual with a Woot sale, so I highly encourage you to have a proper browse yourself.
There's also plenty of other accessories in the sale for other consoles like Xbox and PlayStation, and standout being the PS5 DualSense Controller in Midnight Black for $57.49.
Woot's early sale lasts until November 1, but you've only got until November 1 at 11:59 pm CT to use the SAVETOBER promo code. Limited time only, so I'd get a move on if you're looking to pick up any early deals.
Robert Anderson is a Senior Commerce Editor for IGN. Based in London, UK, he is a qualified journalist with a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism (First Class Degree) and over seven years of professional writing and editing experience.
You can usually find Robert lost in open-world RPG games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077. Outside of gaming, his passions include reading comics (especially Superman, Batman, and Spider-Man), taking photos, and keeping up with the latest in film and TV.
His primary coverage focuses on tracking down the best gaming deals and diving into the fast-paced world of Trading Card Games (TCGs). He regularly covers everything from the latest releases in Pokémon TCG and the most expensive cards to comprehensive Magic: The Gathering buying guides .
